headlines.title: 大行评级丨小摩：香港证监会目标明年上半年推房托通，料领展为主要受惠者
headlines.summary: 摩根大通发表研报指，香港证监会行政总裁梁凤仪透露目标于明年上半年推出房托通(REITs通)，是自2024年提出以来首次公布官方具体时间表，认为虽然存在监管不确定性，正式推出时间或会延迟，但至少目前有更清晰时间表。该行指，投资者对房托通的预期已因长期等待而淡化，相信最新言论或可重新引起市场的期待。按现行南向通纳入标准（恒生综合指数成份股、平均市值逾50亿港元），预期目前有三只香港上市房托将符合资格，包括领展、置富产业信托及冠君产业信托。由于领展是流动性最高的港股REIT，该行相信将成主要受惠者，给予“增持”评级，目标价43港元。

headlines.title_en: Major bank ratings丨JPMorgan: Hong Kong SFC aims to launch REIT Connect in the first half of next year, Link REIT expected to be the main beneficiary
headlines.summary_en: JPMorgan said in a research report that Hong Kong SFC CEO Julia Leung revealed a target to launch REIT Connect in the first half of next year, the first official specific timetable since it was proposed in 2024. The bank believes that although regulatory uncertainty exists and the official launch may be delayed, at least there is now a clearer timetable. It said investor expectations for REIT Connect have faded due to the long wait, and believes the latest remarks may rekindle market anticipation. Under the current Southbound Stock Connect inclusion criteria (Hang Seng Composite Index constituents, average market capitalization above HK$5 billion), it expects three Hong Kong-listed REITs to currently qualify, including Link REIT, Fortune REIT, and Champion REIT. Since Link REIT is the most liquid Hong Kong-listed REIT, the bank believes it will be the main beneficiary, giving it an Overweight rating and a target price of HK$43.

headlines.title_en: RBA rate hike expectations heat up amid divided stances within the committee
headlines.summary_en: For a central bank that avoids forward guidance at all costs, the Reserve Bank of Australia has done a lot of conspicuous work over the past month to prepare financial markets for a possible rate hike next week. Notably, the密集 remarks by senior RBA officials may also have been aimed at securing support votes within the committee. In the spirit of open debate on the committee, RBA Governor Michele Bullock said she has only "one vote." Non-executive director Ian Ross said this week that there is no evidence of a wage-price spiral. His dovish stance may suggest a possible split in next week's vote.

headlines.title_en: A-share Shanghai Composite loses 3,900 points
headlines.summary_en: [A-share Shanghai Composite Index falls below 3900 points] On the 24th, A-shares opened lower and moved lower, with the Shanghai Composite Index falling below 3900 points during the session, down 0.93%. The Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index both fell more than 1.6%. More than 4,200 stocks across the market declined. By sector, precious metals fell sharply, while real estate, pharmaceuticals, electronic components, biotechnology, petrochemicals, communication equipment, and semiconductors led the declines. Banks and education rose.

headlines.title: 苏州公积金新政支持装修提取 最高额度15万元
headlines.summary: 9月24日，苏州住房公积金管理中心发布《关于支持装修提取住房公积金的通知》。其中提出，缴存人及其配偶在全国范围内无住房公积金贷款余额，对苏州市行政区域内自住住房进行装修的，可就名下同一套住房申请提取住房公积金。所有提取人累计提取额不超过房屋装饰装修增值税发票金额，且不超过15万元。个人住房公积金账户须至少按最新缴存基数留存一个月的缴存额（不含新职工补贴）。

headlines.title_en: Suzhou new housing provident fund policy supports renovation withdrawals, maximum amount 150,000 yuan
headlines.summary_en: On September 24, the Suzhou Housing Provident Fund Management Center issued the Notice on Supporting Housing Provident Fund Withdrawals for Renovation. It proposed that if depositors and their spouses have no outstanding housing provident fund loan balance nationwide and renovate self-occupied housing within the administrative area of Suzhou, they may apply to withdraw housing provident fund for the same property under their names. The cumulative withdrawal amount of all withdrawers shall not exceed the amount on the value-added tax invoice for housing decoration and renovation, and shall not exceed 150,000 yuan. The individual housing provident fund account must retain at least one month's deposit amount based on the latest deposit base (excluding new employee subsidies).
